inputs.request: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, l, b, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, radial_velocity, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax > 100
inputs.label: parallax>100mas

inputs.request: SELECT GAIA_HEALPIX_INDEX(3, source_id) AS hpx, COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 11 GROUP BY hpx
inputs.label: healpix3 density G<11
